ai_summary: Flexituff Ventures International Limited has announced the immediate resignation of Mrs. Gudiya Yadav, a Non-Executive Non-Independent Woman Director, effective July 27, 2026. Her departure also removes her from the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and Stakeholders' Relationship Committee, necessitating a replacement. While the stated reason for resignation is "personal reasons" with explicit confirmation of no other material causes, such generalized explanations can sometimes be a subtle red flag for investors, potentially masking deeper operational or governance issues.
